reason: The Manage menu follows the APG menu-button pattern: menuitems have tabindex=-1 and focus sits on the menu, so Tab skipping View all plans is by design. With the keyboard only, Tab to Manage and Enter opens the menu with focus on View all plans, and Enter on it opens the Choose a Plan dialog and moves focus into it.

The sweep pressed Enter and Space on the tabindex=0 tooltip wrapper div around the delete button, not on the button. The next Tab stop is the button itself, and both Enter and Space on it open the Delete Business Client Meals? dialog and move focus into it.
